title: hush_restore
description: RESERVED for Phase 6B (T6.12) — shape from hush-prd.md §7.1 hush_restore, FR-23, FR-20; not routed yet. CEP WNC_HUSH.restore (signed bridge). Undo: the backup becomes the open sequence under the original name; the cut version is kept, renamed '<name> (Hush cut HH:MM:SS)'.

backupId.description: the backup sequence id (hush_cut readback backup.id)

originalName.description: the name to give back to the backup

restored.description: whether the swap happened: its type is not stated in the PRD, left open

readback.description: restored. The object stays open: the PRD lists these keys, keys the host adds are not rejected.
